title.zh: 将阿克兰省 Makato 市镇一所描笼涯中学的 Cayangwan 附属校分离，设立独立的 Cayangwan 国立中学并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Calimbajan Tina Barangay High School Annex in Barangay Cayangwan, Makato, Aklan, From the Calimbajan Barangay High School in Barangay Calimbajan, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Cayangwan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Calimbajan Tina Barangay High School Annex in Barangay Cayangwan, Makato, Aklan, From the Calimbajan Barangay High School in Barangay Calimbajan, and Converting It Into An Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Cayangwan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Calimbajan Tina Barangay tại Barangay Cayangwan, Đô thị Makato, Tỉnh Aklan khỏi Trường Trung học Calimbajan Barangay và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Cayangwan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calimbajan Tina Barangay ในบารังไกย์ Cayangwan เทศบาล Makato จังหวัด Aklan ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calimbajan Barangay และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Cayangwan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Calimbajan Tina Barangay di Barangay Cayangwan, Kotamadya Makato, Provinsi Aklan dari Sekolah Menengah Calimbajan Barangay dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cayangwan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Calimbajan Tina Barangay di Barangay Cayangwan, Perbandaran Makato, Wilayah Aklan daripada Sekolah Menengah Calimbajan Barangay dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cayangwan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Calimbajan Tina Barangay High School Annex in Barangay Cayangwan, Makato, Aklan, is hereby separated from the Calimbajan Barangay High School in Barangay Calimbajan, and converted into an independent national high school, to be known as the Cayangwan National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets, and liabilities of the Calimbajan Tina Barangay High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Cayangwan National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
